requirement_code_evidence_decisions.assessment: Ownerul unic, lockul RuntimeClient si command_lock Host nu sunt inlocuite sau ocolite. Asteptarea CREATE poate tine mai mult lockul clientului, inclusiv fata de status/renew/drain; aceasta nu prelungește grantul deja emis. Quiesce ramane bounded2.5s si refuza SHUTDOWN_INCOMPLETE daca nu poate certifica drain; nicio noua cale nu fabrica STOPPED. Watchdogul independent si revocarea lifeline in Stop raman active. Host revalideaza identitatea/starea/deadline dupa Settings read, dupa management Stop si dupa launch; Stop/fencing in aceste ferestre nu poate fi reinterpretat ca autorizatie noua.

requirement_code_evidence_decisions.assessment: Nu apare shield/catch gol/retry/reconnect/resend sau swallowed CancelledError in delta. Timeout/transport failure din exchange inchide streamul; managed inchide si la BaseException, apoi reridica. NativeTaskOwner normalizeaza RuntimeUnavailable la TASK_INDETERMINATE fara a transforma anularea externa in succes. EOF la Host cancels operation si aduna ambele taskuri; launch face Stop si reridica. Timerul mai larg permite observarea refuzului/cleanupului, nu acceptarea unui raspuns expirat.
